title: Latching alarm annunciator with reset
nl_spec: An alarm annunciator monitors a trip condition. When Trip becomes active the Alarm latches ON and stays on until the operator presses Reset. A Reset must NOT clear the alarm while the trip condition is still active (you cannot reset away a live fault). Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named alarm_ctrl with inputs Trip, Reset and output Alarm.

safety_properties.nl: While the trip condition is active, the alarm is always on.
A set alarm can only clear via Reset (it never drops on its own).

scenarios.description: Latch on trip, hold, clear on reset

notes: Set-dominant latch (Trip checked before Reset). P2 uses the LTL next operator X to express the latch-retention property.
